stops.name: Bangkok
areas: On the BTS line, rooftop bars and clubs, many Indian veg places around Soi 11. Best nightlife base and best NYE base.
Business district, good value, BTS and MRT, Patpong and Silom Soi 4 nightlife.
Backpacker strip, close to Grand Palace, noisy and basic.
highlights: Chatuchak weekend market and Jodd Fairs night market
Khao San Road and Thonglor clubs
Chao Phraya riverside and rooftop bars

veg.name: Khana Khazana
veg.blurb: Pure Indian vegetarian restaurant with North Indian, South Indian and Gujarati food.

veg.name: Indus
veg.blurb: The food is mainly authentic north Indian with a wide range of spicy Indian tastes.

nightlife.name: Wat Saket and Golden Mount
nightlife.blurb: Two coffee shops on the grounds of the temple - one to the left of the entrance of the compound and one on the staircase on the ascent of the Mount

nightlife.name: Amorosa Bar and The Deck
nightlife.blurb: Tourist flock to the rooftop bar Amorosa for its spectacular sunset views of Wat Arun.

nightlife.name: Angel Witch
nightlife.blurb: A single stage, with choreographed shows most evening at 22:00 until 00:00.

sights.name: Pavilion of Regalia, Royal Decorations and Thai Coins
sights.blurb: It houses an impressive array of gold jewellery, weaponry and coins, and gives some insight into the evolution of the dynasty and its elaborate royal ceremonies

sights.name: Wat Ratchabophit
sights.blurb: Built by King Rama V in 1869, it was created to keep up with the tradition that each newly-appointed monarch erected a temple to mark his reign.

sights.name: Wat Ratchanaddaram
sights.blurb: Wat Ratchanaddaram is a temple compound built by order of King Rama III in 1846.

sights.name: Wat Ratchapradit
sights.blurb: This quiet and modest wat is a nice get-away from the busy street and annoying tuk-tuk drivers.

sights.name: Wat Saket and the Golden Mount
sights.blurb: Wat Saket was built outside of the former city walls in the late 18th-century in the reign of King Rama I.

sights.name: Wat Suthat and the Giant Swing
sights.blurb: This wat is becoming more and more off the beaten path as it is quite hard to walk here from the Grand Palace.

sights.name: Wat Thep Thida Ram
sights.blurb: The temple was built in 1836, during the reign of King Rama III.

stops.name: Koh Phangan
areas: Full Moon Party beach and the island's busiest bar strip. Loud; best base for party nights.
Ferry pier town with the night market and most veg food. Cheaper, central, 20 min to Haad Rin.
Yoga and vegan cafe belt in the north-west. Quiet; take a taxi to parties.
highlights: Haad Rin beach and the party strip

sights.name: Archery
sights.blurb: Four archers can have a go at the same time.

sights.name: Diving
sights.blurb: Ko Pha-ngan has lovely sites around the island which are perfect for both beginners and trained divers.

sights.name: Full Moon Party
sights.blurb: If you're after party heaven you can't do better than Haad Rin, an expanded village of beach bars, cheap chicken burgers, and low cut figure-hugging outfits.

sights.name: Herbal Sauna
sights.blurb: The herbal sauna at Wat Pho with separated men's/women's rooms is a great relief after long party nights.

sights.name: Hiking
sights.blurb: Can be done all around the island.

sights.name: Muay Thai
sights.blurb: Gyms such as Chinnarach offer training and workout facilities, as well as camps such as "Horizon" located in Haad Tien (east) which is an intensive training cam

sights.name: Watersports
sights.blurb: Rent or take courses in sailing, windsurfing, kite-surfing or paddle boarding.

sights.name: Yoga
sights.blurb: Offered at multiple places including Agama Yoga, which is in the northwest of the island and has month-long intensive courses.

stays.name: Bungalow Near Chaloklum Beach
stays.kind: Tiny home in Ko Pha-ngan District

stops.name: Krabi
areas: Base for Railay and island boats. Beach strip has bars and Indian food. Quieter than Patong.
Car-free peninsula, longtail boat from Ao Nang. Stay here only for a quiet beach trip.
highlights: Railay day: longtail from Ao Nang, Phra Nang cave beach, viewpoint
Ao Nang night market and beach bars

nightlife.name: Rick's Bar
nightlife.blurb: At most bars in Ao Nang and elsewhere, you're served by a disinterested employee and lucky if you get a smile.

nightlife.name: Sweet Bar
nightlife.blurb: If you fancy a chilled out drink and few games of pool in a friendly location, go for a drink adjacent to Nopparat Thara Beach.

nightlife.name: Ting Tong Bar
nightlife.blurb: Spacious, clean bar with good music at a level that permits conversation, and a good pool table.

nightlife.name: Coco's
nightlife.blurb: The place to catch the sunset.

nightlife.name: Rai Lay Bay Resort Bar
nightlife.blurb: The bar is on the beachfront and is lined with stools and shaded by the nearby palm trees.

nightlife.name: Cocktail Bar
nightlife.blurb: A fun, relaxed place to have a cocktail or two.

nightlife.name: Last Bar
nightlife.blurb: It's the closest thing to a dance club Rai Leh has to offer.

sights.name: Fossil Shell Beach
sights.blurb: This overblown tourist attraction has slates of compressed 40 million year old shellfish, which resemble concrete.

sights.name: Lagoon & Viewpoint
sights.blurb: The climb to the top takes about 20-25 minutes and to the viewpoint another 10 minutes.

sights.name: Phra Nang Cave
sights.blurb: An interesting place to explore and one of the few strictly sightseeing destinations at Rai Leh.

sights.name: Phra Nang Shrine
sights.blurb: Dedicated to the spirit of the drowned princess (phra nang) who gave the beach her name, this small shrine in a small cave is notable primarily for the dozens o

sights.name: Ao Nang Beach
sights.blurb: Ao Nang Beach, lined with shops and restaurants, is more like a base for exploring Krabi than an important destination in itself.

sights.name: Nopparat Thara Beach
sights.blurb: Long beach at the western edge of Ao Nang, zoned as a national park.
